title: Prepare Products within separated Packages, UI Kit, Laioutr UI and Laioutr UI Pro
description:
We defined our UI Products:

* Laioutr UI Kit
* Laioutr UI
* Laioutr UI Pro

We need to separate our current ui package into 3 packages.

enrichedData.purpose: The existing monolithic UI package needs to be reorganized into three distinct product packages (UI Kit, Laioutr UI, Laioutr UI Pro) to support different product tiers and customer needs.
useCases: Separate the current UI package into Laioutr UI Kit
Separate the current UI package into Laioutr UI
Separate the current UI package into Laioutr UI Pro
